attemptEtherTransfer(address,uint256).details: Isolated subcall: a false/reverting ETH recipient rolls back so the entitlement stays pending.

attemptTokenTransfer(address,address,uin.details: Isolated subcall: exact-balance invariant; false/revert stays pending.

ETH_SENTINEL().notice: Sentinel representing native ETH as a uniform asset in tracking/distribution.

checkIn().notice: Resets the dead-man-switch clock (full reset, no partial credit).

claimAutomationReserve().notice: Claims unused automation reserve once distribution is fully complete. Relayer incentive.

closeVault().notice: Permanently closes an empty, active vault. Owner may create a new vault via the factory.

constructor.notice: Only deployable by the factory. Sets ownership and initial inheritance config.

deposit(address,uint256).notice: Deposits a supported ERC-20 (initial asset set: USDC). Fee-on-transfer is rejected.

depositETH().notice: Deposits native ETH into the vault as a protected asset.

distributeInheritanceAsset(address).notice: Snapshots and distributes one asset after inheritance is triggered.

eligibilityDeadline().notice: The timestamp at which inheritance becomes eligible (pinned formula).

protectedAssetBalance(address).notice: Current protected balance of an asset (live, never cached).

retryInheritanceDistribution(address,add.notice: Retries one failed entitlement after the retry interval has elapsed.

state().notice: Derived, authoritative state per the documented state machine.

updateBeneficiaries(address[],uint16[]).notice: Replaces the beneficiary list (exact 100% allocation enforced).

updateSettings(uint64,uint8).notice: Updates check-in interval and missed-check-in limit.

withdraw(address,uint256).notice: Withdraws ERC-20 or native ETH (ETH_SENTINEL) back to the owner's wallet.
